shortDescription: Add, remove, or move an ESXi host to, from, or within vCenter

options.name: add_connected
options.description: If set to V(true), then the host should be connected as soon as it is added. This parameter is ignored if not O(state=present).

options.name: cluster_name
options.description: Name of the cluster to add the host. If O(folder) is not set, then this parameter is required.

options.name: datacenter_name
options.description: Name of the datacenter to add the host.

options.name: esxi_password
options.description: ESXi password. Required for adding a host. Optional for reconnect. Unused for removing. No longer a required parameter from version 2.5.

options.name: esxi_ssl_thumbprint
options.description: Specifying the hostsystem certificate's thumbprint. Use following command to get hostsystem certificate's thumbprint -  # openssl x509 -in /etc/vmware/ssl/rui.crt -fingerprint -sha1 -noout

options.name: esxi_username
options.description: ESXi username. Required for adding a host. Optional for reconnect. If both O(esxi_username) and O(esxi_password) are used Unused for removing. No longer a required parameter from version 2.5.

options.name: fetch_ssl_thumbprint
options.description: Fetch the thumbprint of the host's SSL certificate. This basically disables the host certificate verification (check if it was signed by a recognized CA). Disable this option if you want to allow only hosts with valid certificates to be added to vCenter. If this option is set to V(false) and the certificate can't be verified, an add or reconnect will fail. Unused when O(esxi_ssl_thumbprint) is set. Optional for reconnect, but only used if O(esxi_username) and O(esxi_password) are used. Unused fo

options.name: folder
options.description: Name of the folder under which host to add. If O(cluster_name) is not set, then this parameter is required. For example, if there is a datacenter 'dc1' under folder called 'Site1' then, this value will be '/Site1/dc1/host'. Here 'host' is an invisible folder under VMware Web Client. Another example, if there is a nested folder structure like '/myhosts/india/pune' under datacenter 'dc2', then O(folder) value will be '/dc2/host/myhosts/india/pune'. Other Examples: '/Site2/dc2/Asia-Cluster/host' or

options.name: force_connection
options.description: Force the connection if the host is already being managed by another vCenter server.

options.name: hostname
options.description: The hostname or IP address of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PASSWORD) will be used instead.

options.name: port
options.description: The port number of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_host
options.description: The address of a proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. The format is a hostname or a IP. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_HOST) will be used instead.

options.name: proxy_port
options.description: The port of the HTTP proxy that will receive all HTTPS requests and relay them. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_PROXY_PORT) will be used instead.

options.name: reconnect_disconnected
options.description: Reconnect disconnected hosts. This is only used if O(state=present) and if the host already exists.

options.name: state
options.description: If set to V(present), add the host if host is absent. If set to V(present), update the location of the host if host already exists. If set to V(absent), remove the host if host is present. If set to V(absent), do nothing if host already does not exists. If set to V(add_or_reconnect), add the host if it's absent else reconnect it and update the location. If set to V(reconnect), then reconnect the host if it's present and update the location. options.name: username
options.description: The username of the vSphere vCenter server. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_USER) will be used instead.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Allows connection when SSL certificates are not valid. Set to V(false) when certificates are not trusted. If the value is not specified in the task, the value of environment variable E(VMWARE_VALIDATE_CERTS) will be used instead.
